name: Flux (FLUX.1-dev/schnell)
description: Black Forest Labs - Natural language, detailed, artistic Ported verbatim from EricRollei/Local_LLM_Prompt_Enhancer.
length_guidance: Aim for about 200 words (or more) with layered, cinematic imagery.
detail_expectation: Deliver ultra-detailed, sensory-rich storytelling with multiple focal elements.
preferences: Artistic style references (e.g., 'in the style of...')
negative_prompt_default: blurry, low quality, distorted, deformed, ugly, bad anatomy, watermark, signature, text
platform_block:
FLUX-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
- Natural language descriptions (75-150 tokens)
- Use artistic terminology
- Can include "in the style of [artist/style]"
- Quality modifiers important
- Photography terms work well
few_shot_intro: Example transformations of a user idea into a Flux (FLUX.1-dev/schnell)-formatted prompt:
user_message_schema_hint: The user message arrives as JSON with fields: { raw_idea, target_model, source_image_count, aspect_ratio, camera_details?, references? }. Weave camera_details naturally into the prompt — do NOT echo them as a settings list at the end.

provenance.notes: Ported verbatim. EricRollei's original field names and ordering preserved; platform_block lifted from text_to_image_node.py when present, otherwise empty (the master template + preferences/avoid/quality_tokens alone are enough for platforms without a bespoke block).
